
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

d <- read_csv(here("sim_res/01_param_search_summarized/surprisal_summarized.csv"))
```

```{r}
d %>% 
  distinct(trial_id, param_id, sample_n_mean, sample_n_std, fam_duration, test_type) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = fam_duration, y = sample_n_mean, color = test_type)) +
```
